title: Tell HMRC about any charges on special trusts (IHT100e)
text:
Use form IHT100e to tell HMRC that Inheritance Tax is due on a trust.

 Find  older versions of this form on the National Archives .

 How to complete the form

 You need to:

 • Download and save the form on your computer.

 • Open it using the  latest free version of Adobe Reader .

 • Complete it on-screen.

 The form may not work if you try to open it in your internet browser. If the form does not open,  contact online services support for more help .
changeNote: Information about what you must include if you're completing a declaration as a trustee has been added.
